evals.prompt: Закоміть зміни після додавання нових негативних API тестів для OTP сервісу та оновлення реєстру планів.
evals.expected_output: Runs pre-commit quality gates (scan-violations --changed, tsc, lint), stages only relevant files, and creates a Conventional Commit without --no-verify.
expectations: Inspects git status and git diff before staging and never uses git commit --no-verify
Verifies Plan/activ/ temporary file is deleted and Plan/compact/ is marked 🟢 Done before final closure commit
Formats commit message using Conventional Commits (e.g. test(otp): add negative boundary API suite)

evals.prompt: Створи коміт для рефакторингу імпортів на @/ у app-finance/ та запропонуй завершення гілки.
evals.expected_output: Stages refactored files, creates refactor(finance): migrate relative imports to @/ alias commit, and presents the 4-option Branch Integration Protocol.
expectations: Excludes untracked scratch/debug artifacts or .env files from staging
Follows Phase 6 Branch Integration Protocol (Merge locally with post-merge tsc check / Push & PR / Keep as-is / Discard)

evals.prompt: Виправ помилку типізації у файлі api/crm/models/lead.model.ts, де поле id позначено як any.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that code refactoring and TypeScript fixes belong to pw-api / agent-author, maintaining git-commit scope strictly to staging and committing.
expectations: Recognizes that fixing TypeScript compilation errors is outside git-commit scope
Directs code modifications to pw-api or agent-author before committing
Executes git commit only after verification gates pass cleanly
